about: Verified Florida entries held for a decision: nothing reads this folder, so Florida's site data is unchanged. To load them, move these programs into data/local-FL.json (docs/county-coverage.md).

programs.title: Community Grants (CG) Program
programs.agency: Miami-Dade County Department of Cultural Affairs
programs.objectives: Small and large community-based cultural programs, projects and events, in four quarterly rounds.
programs.who: Nonprofit organizations developing community-based cultural programs; see the guidelines.
programs.application: Apply on the department's online grants system (see the guidelines on the program page).
programs.award: Up to $7,500 for first-time applicants; up to $15,000 for large recurring events.
programs.deadlines: Fourth quarter applications close February 18, 2027, before 5 p.m. The December 3, 2026 round is on hold.

programs.title: Cultural Advancement (ADV) Grants
programs.agency: Miami-Dade County Department of Cultural Affairs
programs.objectives: General operating support for a designated group of mid to large arts organizations, on a three-year cycle with invitation to apply.
programs.who: Qualified and invited arts organizations with a historical budget over $500,000.
programs.application: Apply on the department's online grants system (see the guidelines on the program page).
programs.deadlines: FY 2026-2027 applications closed March 9, 2026. The program runs on a three-year review cycle.

programs.title: Cultural Development (CDG) Grants
programs.agency: Miami-Dade County Department of Cultural Affairs
programs.objectives: General operating support for mid-sized arts organizations.
programs.who: A selected group of mid-sized arts organizations; see the guidelines.
programs.application: Apply on the department's online grants system (see the guidelines on the program page).
programs.deadlines: FY 2026-2027 applications closed April 9, 2026. No next date is published.

programs.title: Developing Arts in Neighborhoods (DAN) Grants
programs.agency: Miami-Dade County Department of Cultural Affairs
programs.objectives: Support for small and developing cultural groups with budgets under $100,000.
programs.who: Cultural groups with budgets under $100,000 and a two-year record. Governments and colleges are not eligible.
programs.application: Apply on the department's online grants system (see the guidelines on the program page).
programs.deadlines: FY 2026-2027 applications closed April 9, 2026. No next date is published.

programs.title: Festivals and Special Events (FEST) Grants
programs.agency: Miami-Dade County Department of Cultural Affairs
programs.objectives: Major annual festivals and special events.
programs.who: Organizations producing major annual festivals and special events; see the divisions' requirements.
programs.application: Apply on the department's online grants system (see the guidelines on the program page).
programs.award: Up to $145,000, by category and division.
programs.deadlines: FY 2026-2027 applications closed March 9, 2026. No next date is published.

programs.title: Hannibal Cox, Jr. (HCJ) Cultural Grants
programs.agency: Miami-Dade County Department of Cultural Affairs
programs.objectives: Support for mid-sized arts, science and history organizations.
programs.who: Mid-sized arts, science and history organizations with a three-year record and budgets of $100,000 to $250,000. Governments are not eligible.
programs.application: Apply on the department's online grants system (see the guidelines on the program page).
programs.deadlines: FY 2026-2027 applications closed March 12, 2026. No next date is published.

programs.title: Sponsorships
programs.agency: Children's Services Council of Broward County
programs.objectives: Limited sponsorship dollars for charitable groups.
programs.who: Charitable groups; see the sponsorship policy.
programs.application: Use the Apply here link on the page.
